item.title: Anastacia Gets Down to Funny Business For Australian Comedy Show ‘Urzila’: Watch
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard. Today, we're talking about a hilarious new comedy sketch featuring the one and only Anastacia.
[Short music transition]
Host: The U.S. singer and songwriter, known for her powerful voice and hits like "I'm Outta Love" and "Left Outside Alone", made a cameo appearance in the Australian comedy series Urzila, led by comedian and actress Urzila Carlson. In the sketch, Anastacia puts a group of backing dancers through their paces, including Urzila, who impresses her with some... unconventional choreography.
[Short music transition]
Host: Despite being a bit of an unconventional dancer, Urzila wins over Anastacia, who loves her energy and unique style. As a result, Urzila gets to lead the choreography for Anastacia's next single, a "dancehall banger". The sketch is full of laughs, with Urzila busting out moves like finger guns and "drunk aunty at a wedding" vibes.
[Short music transition]
Host: Anastacia recently teased the sketch on her social media, saying it was an absolute blast to film and that viewers are "gonna laugh their head off". If you want to check it out, you can catch the sketch on the Australian Broadcasting Corporation or on-demand at ABC iView.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's it for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one.
